theorem add_mem_translationTube_one {S : Set EuclideanPlane} {x : EuclideanPlane}
    (hx : x ∈ S) (v : EuclideanPlane) :
    x + v ∈ translationTube S v :=
  by
  rcases (translationTube S v).mem_eq_iff.mp hx x v with h_mem
  simp at h_mem
  -- The translationTube is defined as { p ∈ EuclideanPlane | (p - v) ∈ S }
  -- So we need to check if (x + v - v) ∈ S
  have h_sub : (x + v) - v = x := by
    simp [WithLp.toLp]
    rfl
  rw [h_sub] at h_mem
  exact hx
